screen.volatility_formula: sample_std(close_t/close_tminus1-1 over current20)*sqrt(252); 21 consecutive positive finite closes; excludes corporate action adjustment
screen.listing_age_rule: calendar open sessions since listing effective_from; start clipped to 2019 for older listings, guaranteed >=120 before first decision
screen.next_open_rule: next open calendar_session joined by venue; valid listing/security [from,to), positive finite open, tradable and can_buy true, positive finite upper limit, open < upper-0.005
screen.unknown_rule: missing/invalid required input blocks admission; disjoint ordered reason ledger
screen.control: baseline AND finite momentum20 outside original closed band

decision.consumer: #608 research allocator and prospective signal-screen protocol
decision.primary_metric: mean paired same-date/venue candidate-control T+1-open to T+2-open raw-price response

branches.insufficient: inconclusive; park this raw-band calendar-aligned screen; retain exact shortfall
branches.advance: supported for retaining distribution-level evidence only; wait for a separately named consumer; R4 remains park
branches.below_minimum: not_met for this fixed raw-band calendar-aligned screen; park and direct next selection budget to an independent question
branches.uncertain: inconclusive; park this screen branch; preserve exposure/cost and require material new evidence for reopening

exposure.predecessor: All R1/R2/R4 same-window exposure, failures and costs retained; 2021-12-30 decision excluded prospectively to preserve T+2<=2021-12-31
exposure.question_delta: One calendar-aligned label and exact intraday/overnight decomposition on the population, used for screen-resource disposition; no R4 capital replay reopening
exposure.recompute_reason: Owner activated R5 autonomous research; one formal computation and one independent construction for the new predeclared question

analysis.consumer: #608 research allocator and prospective signal-screen protocol
analysis.question: Does the fixed raw-momentum20 band retain its incremental price response over the calendar-aligned T+1 open to T+2 open interval, enough to retain this distribution-level screen branch?
analysis.baseline: R1 universe and all original filters except momentum band; finite momentum required
analysis.candidate: baseline AND momentum20 in original closed [0.02,0.12] band
analysis.control: baseline AND finite momentum20 outside original closed band
analysis.label: T+2 unadjusted open / T+1 unadjusted open - 1; exact next two venue calendar sessions, valid identity and positive finite prices; calendar-aligned price response only
analysis.aggregation: Equal-weight listings within each date/venue/group; candidate minus disjoint control; mean the two venue differences within each paired date, then equal-weight paired dates
analysis.minimum_mean_increment_rationale: Prospective 5bp minimum information-difference threshold for this resource-routing screen, inherited as a conservative fixed requirement from R2; not an economic break-even threshold

bootstrap.method: year-stratified circular moving blocks of paired dates

secondary: intraday response on the same common cohort
overnight response on the same common cohort
